claims.text: Repository-centered peer review and graph-based reviewer discovery predate TDRG.
claims.evidence: Rodriguez et al. describe an OAI-PMH peer-review service using a social-network algorithm for reviewer selection and influence weighting.
claims.caveat: Does not exhaust all earlier repository-review systems.
claims.unresolved_question: Whether a systematic search would identify an even closer precursor.

claims.text: Fair/randomized assignment and global, root-relative, and local graph trust are prior work, not protocol inventions.
claims.evidence: Primary papers define the mapped assignment and trust mechanisms in their original domains.
claims.caveat: Prior-domain results do not transfer automatically to scientific review governance.
claims.unresolved_question: Which exact baseline implementations will be frozen for TM-18?

claims.text: Anonymous review and anonymous reputation mechanisms predate TDRG.
claims.evidence: Naessens et al. present anonymous credential-based review with accountability; AnonRep presents tracking-resistant anonymous reputation under an explicit provider model.
claims.caveat: The systems have different threat models and do not validate TDRG case personas.
claims.unresolved_question: Which privacy mechanism, if any, should a future profile adopt?

claims.text: TDRG defines typed shared events separately from local, scoped trust views and prohibits a universal actor score.
claims.caveat: Definition is proposed and not field-validated.

claims.text: Eleven unit tests passed at revision 9da0cd4 in the recorded local rerun.
claims.evidence: Local command output in verification.md records 11 tests, 11 passing.
claims.caveat: Local, synthetic, non-archival, and not independently rerun.
claims.unresolved_question: When will a tagged immutable release and independent rerun be available?

claims.text: The implemented deterministic check is equality under event reversal in one fixture, not cross-platform byte-identical canonical replay.
claims.caveat: No clean-environment or cross-runtime digest comparison.
claims.unresolved_question: Canonical serialization format is not yet chosen.

claims.text: No signatures, uniqueness, Sybil/collusion defenses, personas, appeals, forks, standards round trips, rollback, or A0--A4 comparison exist in the current slice.
claims.evidence: Source, schema, fixtures, tests, and repository documentation inventory at revision 9da0cd4.
claims.unresolved_question: Roadmap ordering and implementer ownership remain open.

claims.text: Conformance to named fixtures does not establish scientific validity or community benefit.
claims.evidence: Conformance tuple binds implementation behavior; validity requires domain judgment and field benefit requires separate empirical evidence.
claims.caveat: A later field study could support a narrower benefit claim.
claims.unresolved_question: Paper 04 study design is outside this manuscript.

claims.text: NISO, COAR Notify, DocMaps, Crossref, PROV-O, and RO-Crate cover portions of terminology, exchange, event description, registration, provenance, and packaging.
claims.evidence: Dated official specifications and documentation state the mapped functions.
claims.citation: niso2023peerreview; coar2024notify; docmaps2021framework; crossref2026peerreview; lebo2013provo; soilandreyes2022rocrate; rocrate2025spec
claims.caveat: No TDRG round trip has been implemented.
claims.unresolved_question: Extension and loss boundaries require fixtures.

claims.text: A0--A4 improvements and H1--H6 are open hypotheses.
claims.evidence: No comparison implementation, seed manifest, dataset, or report exists.
claims.caveat: Hypotheses may be null, reversed, or dominated by subgroup harms and cost.
claims.unresolved_question: Freeze precision, multiplicity, harm, and stop thresholds before execution.

claims.text: The case-persona design provides anonymity or unlinkability.
claims.evidence: No persona or privacy implementation and no attack report exist.
claims.caveat: Current manuscript states only desired semantics and downgrade rules.
claims.unresolved_question: External privacy/security design and review required.

claims.text: The multiaxis resource classifier preserves compute, storage, access, human/agent intelligence, and support axes, while non-full modes declare exclusions.
claims.evidence: Three resource-profile unit tests and resources.py at revision 9da0cd4.
claims.caveat: R0--R3 thresholds are prototype policy, not validated standards.
claims.unresolved_question: Threshold parameterization and domain review remain pending.
